captions.instagram:
Picking up holiday work on an app or at pop-ups this season? That money arrives with no tax taken out.

✔️ $400 or more of net self-employment earnings means self-employment tax (Social Security and Medicare) and a return to file.
✔️ Payments from September 1 to December 31 are covered by the estimated payment due January 15, 2027.
✔️ Keep a mileage log from the first trip and save receipts for what you buy for the work. They lower your profit.
✔️ Easiest habit: move part of every payout into a separate savings account the day it lands.

Source: IRS, Self-employment tax; Estimated tax FAQ.
